intro: This critical phase of the Forsaken campaign against Southshore's surrounding holdings targets the civic leadership of Hillsbrad town. Directed by High Executor Darthalia from Tarren Mill, Horde forces strike at Magistrate Burnside, his council, and their administrative records to completely shatter human governance in the foothills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall. We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting. We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council. Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation. And while you're at it, steal the town registry.

clips.title: Completion
paras: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast. You have done well, adventurer.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
